name: token-usage-counter
description: Tracks Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI token usage and costs per session, with tools to analyze daily spending.

pricing_file.title: Pricing file path
pricing_file.description: Path to a custom pricing JSON, used for both runtimes. When unset, each runtime uses its own bundled file: scripts/claude-pricing.json for Claude Code, scripts/copilot-pricing.json for Copilot CLI.
